name: koko
description: Kòkó: book independent photographers, barbers, braiders and makeup artists in Lagos. Installable React + TypeScript PWA with live availability, slot holds, deposits and a studio dashboard.

paragraphs: Book the hands behind the work. Kòkó is a booking web app for independent creatives in Lagos and Abuja: photographers, barbers, braiders and makeup artists who run their own diaries. Clients browse real portfolios, pick a time that is actually free, and secure it with a deposit. Creatives get a small studio dashboard for their week.
It is a front-end project: everything runs in the browser against a mock API that lives in this repo, so it can be cloned and run with no keys and no backend.
features: Discover creatives by craft, city, price and availability. Filters live in the URL, so a filtered list can be shared or bookmarked. On phones the extra filters move into a bottom sheet.
Book a slot in four steps: service, time, details, deposit. Availability comes from opening hours, service length, buffers between clients, lead time and the existing diary.

Your slot is held for 10 minutes while you fill in details, with a visible countdown. Another tab (or another person) can't take it in the meantime, and if a slot you were looking at gets booked elsewhere it disappears…

Pay a deposit by card or bank transfer. Cards are checked (Luhn, expiry, CVV, brand detection for Verve, Visa and Mastercard) and a pretend gateway can approve, decline or report insufficient funds, so the error paths…

Manage bookings: reschedule (up to twice) or cancel, with the policy applied: free cancellation inside the creative's notice window, deposit kept after it. Each booking keeps a history and can be added to a calendar as…
